notes.quote: This paper generally discriminated well between students of all abilities and there were sufficient opportunities for a typical E grade student to gain some marks across many of the questions.

There were some testing questions involving proof, mathematical modelling, differential equations, differentiation and integration that allowed the paper to discriminate well between the higher grades.
